resources.string: Sync stores family finances in Firebase. Google and project administrators can read them. Shared free capacity is limited.
Family sync is unavailable in this build. Local finances and file backups remain available.
Family data will replace finances on this phone. Your previous local data is kept separately for export. It will not be uploaded automatically.
Cancel pending invitations and clear accepted invitations. Members who already joined keep access.
Administrators can invite and remove members and restore family finances.
This administrator becomes the family creator and can manage your administrator role or remove you.
This member loses cloud access. Their app clears family data after confirming removal online. Existing exports cannot be erased.
This frees a connection slot. A phone still signed into a family account can connect again.
Keep the previous family dataset. You can cancel your own restore, or another administrator can cancel after its time limit expires.
Permanently delete this family from Firebase and remove every member. The app clears local family data after confirming removal. Save a backup first if needed.
Waiting for an earlier change to be resolved.
This change is held until the conflict is resolved.
Discard the complete change and later changes that depend on it. Linked loan payments and expenses stay together. Other valid changes can then apply.
Signed out. Changes stay on this phone.
Family data is available. Review before replacing local finances.
Family restore is pending. Resume or cancel it.
Restored data is active. Old-data cleanup is pending.
Cloud capacity reached. Local changes are kept for later sync or export.
Update kinjar before receiving newer family data.
Sync paused. Check your connection and account, then retry. Local data is kept.
Includes finances and pending changes on this phone. Changes not yet received from other phones may be missing.
Kept before replacement. Export a copy to inspect or restore it separately.
Use at least 12 characters. Keep the passphrase in your password manager. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.
This replaces finances for everyone in your family. Memberships stay unchanged. Other phones keep old pending changes separately and must confirm the replacement.
This replaces finances on this phone. A previous local copy is kept separately for export.
